title: Talent triage evidence log + first 30-day activation plan
summary: Working template for interviewer evidence capture, rapid hire triage, and a practical first-30-day activation plan that hiring managers can commit with a candidate offer. Built for technical and product hires but generalizable.
purpose: Reduce time-to-certainty in hiring decisions by standardizing the artifacts interviewers capture. Align new hire onboarding to measurable contribution milestones that map to team OKRs.
evidence_log_template:
Candidate: <name> | Role: <title> | Req ID: <req>
Resume highlights (bullet):
- bullet 1 (years, domain)
- bullet 2 (notable project or company)
Portfolio / code links: <url>
Stage: (phone / on-site / take-home)
Interviewer: <name> (role)
Date/time: YYYY-MM-DD
Exact quotes / signals (verbatim when possible):
- """
Key artifacts seen/linked (PRs, gists, demo videos):
- repo: <url> (commit hash or PR)
- design doc: <url>
Time budget estimate to ramp (interviewer estimate): X weeks
Fit verdict: green / yellow / red
Rationales (1-2 concise sentences):
- Technical depth: specific evidence and gaps
- Collaboration + communication: example exchanges
- Role-specific signals (ownership, product sense, infra experience)
Recommendation: (hire / keep for bench / no hire) and suggested compensation band (optional)
interview_rubric:
Scoring guide: 1 = Concern; 2 = Borderline; 3 = Meets bar; 4 = Exceeds bar. Use evidence phrases for every score.

Criteria (example for SWE / ML infra):
- System design (scale, tradeoffs): 1: no coherent approach; 2: high-level ok but misses ops/cost; 3: clear design with tradeoffs; 4: inventive design + measurable tradeoffs
- Coding & correctness: 1: many bugs; 2: works with hints; 3: correct and idiomatic; 4: clean, tested, performance-aware
- Problem decomposition: 1: jumps to micro-solutions; 2: partial decomposition; 3: good abstractions; 4: anticipates evolution and testing
- Ownership & delivery: 1: vague on past ownership; 2: small ownership examples; 3: led feature releases; 4: owned cross-team initiatives with metrics
- Communication & feedback: 1: unclear, interrupts; 2: sometimes unclear; 3: clear storytelling of past work; 4: persuades and drafts follow-ups
- Culture fit & values: 1: misaligned; 2: unclear; 3: aligned; 4: champion of values

Each interviewer provides 1–2 line evidence for each numeric score. Final composite: average numeric score and a short synthesis (max 3 lines) describing readiness and risk.
triage_matrix:
Purpose: fast decide whether to accelerate an offer, keep candidate warm, or close out.
Axes: Urgency (team hiring priority: High / Medium / Low) vs Certainty (Evidence: High / Medium / Low)
Actions:
- High urgency + High certainty -> Fast-track to offer: exec signoff within 48h, standard comp band, 30-day activation commit
- High urgency + Medium certainty -> Pre-offer additional short loop (live pairing or take-home) with explicitly scoped success criteria
- Medium urgency + High certainty -> Hold for bench / keep warm with clear review date (30 days)
- Low urgency + Low certainty -> Close or re-screen later
Notes: When uncertainty is due to missing evidence (e.g., coding artifacts), prefer short fresh assessment (2-hour pairing) over protracted debate.
manager_hiring_plan_template:
Manager checklist to include in Req packet:
- Role summary (3 lines describing impact)
- Top 3 success outcomes for first 6 months
- Interview panel + primary competency owner for each slot
- Compensation target and flex range
- Ramp plan highlights: first deliverable (week 1–4), first metric (month 1), cross-team dependency
- Risk assessment: skill gaps that are acceptable vs dealbreakers
- Recruiting brief: sourcing channels and must-have keywords
Deliverable: attach to req as single PDF and link to evidence log instances.
first_30_days_activation_plan:
Goal: convert offer into production impact within 30 days for mid-senior ICs.
Structure: Objectives (O), Key Results (KR), Milestones (M), Stakeholders (S), Support Needed (SN)
Example plan for Platform Engineer (first 30 days):
O1: Ship small but customer-visible improvement to model serving reliability
- KR1: Merge fix to autoscaler that reduces 95p latency tail by 15% on staging
- M1 (Week 1): Environment bootstrapped, dev credentials, onboarding docs read
- M2 (Week 2): Reproduce issue and propose fix in PR
- M3 (Week 3): Deploy to canary + run baseline test
- M4 (Week 4): Prod rollout and monitoring dashboard updated
S: manager (name), peer buddy (on-call owner), infra SRE
SN: test dataset, access to staging cluster, previous incident runbook
Weekly check-ins: 1:1 + squad sync; manager completes short progress form (week 1, 2, 4)
Acceptance criteria for continuing ramp: completed baseline PR and monitored rollout or a documented mitigation plan.
early_onboarding_tasks_checklist:
Pre-start (recruiter / ops): offer paperwork, payroll, laptop and account requests, learning plan shared
Day 0–3: team meet-and-greet, infra access, simple onboarding issue assigned, buddy assigned
Week 1: small code change or doc change merged, first 1:1 with manager, goals clarified
Week 2–3: shadowing critical processes (deploy, incident runbooks), start first project work
Week 4: 30-day review: completed items, blockers, updated 30–60–90 plan
Common pitfalls to watch for: lack of clarity on first deliverable, missing access, no buddy assigned
Escalation ladder: buddy -> manager -> hiring manager -> people ops
Checklist owner: hiring manager
Recommended duration for each task is included inline in the long-form onboarding plan.
quick_messages_library: Pre-offer: Thanks for taking the time—next step is a 60m pairing session with X. Can you share 2 times?
Offer acceptance: Welcome! Please review the attached activation guide and confirm your laptop preference.
Bench hold: We enjoyed meeting you; we are pausing active interviewing but would like to keep you in our talent pool for 30 days.
Rejection note: Thank you for your time. At this stage we are not moving forward; we appreciated your work on <specific project> and encourage you to re-apply for <role> in X months.
notes_to_self:
- Encourage interviewers to write verbatim quotes when surprised by a candidate's approach.
- Make the evidence log mandatory for every technical interview (non-empty rubric fields) before panel debrief.
- Track time-to-decision and correlation with evidence completeness monthly. Target median decision time <= 7 days for high-priority reqs.
- Pilot this template with 3 hiring managers for two months and collect feedback.
closing: Next steps: share with hiring managers and recruiting, enable a short training session for interviewers (30 minutes), and add the evidence log to the hiring packet template in Confluence.
